effect: Enabled/not configured (default): users can use WinGet. Disabled: winget still runs and shows help (-?), any other command is reported as disabled by policy.

friendly_name: Enable Windows Package Manager command line interfaces
effect: Enabled/not configured (default): WinGet CLI and PowerShell cmdlets can run, provided EnableAppInstaller isn't disabled. Disabled: users can't execute the WinGet CLI or PowerShell cmdlets. Does not override EnableAppInstaller.

Enabled/not configured (default): users can change WinGet settings (winget settings). Disabled: users can't change settings; the .json settings file could still be edited directly with elevated credentials, which this policy does not prevent.

Enabled/not configured (default): users can enable experimental features. Disabled: users can't enable experimental features (some experimental features may ship before the policy that controls them).

friendly_name: Enable App Installer Local Manifest Files
effect: Enabled/not configured (default): users can install from local manifest files (winget install -m / --manifest). Disabled: local-manifest installs are blocked.
Enabled/not configured (default): users can enable the SHA256 hash-check override in WinGet settings. Disabled: users can't enable the hash override.

friendly_name: Enable App Installer Local Archive Malware Scan Override
effect: Not configured (default): WinGet administrator settings are used. Enabled: users can override the malware scan for a local-manifest archive install. Disabled: users can't override that scan.
Not configured (default): the default (winget) source is available and can be removed. Enabled: available and can't be removed. Disabled: not available.

friendly_name: Enable App Installer Microsoft Store Source
effect: Not configured (default): the msstore source is available and can be removed. Enabled: available and can't be removed. Disabled: not available.

Not configured (default): no additional sources are configured by policy. Enabled: the additional sources supplied by the policy value are added and can't be removed by the user (get the representation from winget source export). Disabled: no additional sources can be configured.
Not configured (default): users can add or remove sources freely. Enabled: only the sources named by the policy can be added or removed. Disabled: no additional sources can be configured.
Enabled: users can install packages from a website using the ms-appinstaller protocol. Disabled/not configured (default): they can't.

friendly_name: Enable App Installer Microsoft Store Source Certificate Validation Bypass
effect: Not configured (default): WinGet administrator settings apply. Enabled: bypasses Microsoft Store certificate validation. Disabled: the certificate is validated as valid and belonging to the Microsoft Store before contacting the Microsoft Store source.
Enabled/not configured (default): users can use the winget configure feature. Disabled: the configuration feature can't be used.

friendly_name: Set App Installer Source Auto Update Interval In Minutes
effect: Disabled/not configured (default): the default interval or the value in WinGet settings is used. Enabled: the number of minutes given by the policy is used. The index is downloaded only when a command runs and the interval has passed (not in the background); no effect on REST-based sources. The CSP page's ADMX mapping names only the registry key, no registry value name.
